summary: Petition seeking approval under Section 17 of the Electricity Act, 2003 for bringing on record the appointment of Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited as the Security Trustee and for creation of security interest over the assets of Petitioner in favour of the Security Trustee, acting on behalf of and for the benefit of the Lenders (and for any subsequent transferees, assign, novatees thereof and any refinancing lenders to the Project), by way of hypothecation and equitable mortgage on the Project assets, pursuant to unattested Deed of Pledge, Declaration, Undertaking and other Financing Agreements, for the development of the Transmission Project. 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition under Section 17 of the Act seeking approval for the creation of security interest over the assets in favour of Respondent No. 2, Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited (hereinafter referred to as the "Security Trustee"), acting for and on behalf of and for the benefit of Respondent Nos. 3 to 7, i.e., _“(a) Approve the creation of security Interest, over the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner and to the extent as mentioned in the Facility Agreement, Security Trustee Agreement and other financing documents, in favour of Security Trustee/ Respondent No. 2 acting on behalf of and for the benefit of the Lenders and for subsequent transferees, assigns, novates thereof and any refinancing lenders of the Project, by way of creation of security on Project assets, pursuant to the Financing Agreements executed in this regard;_ _(b) Approve any future security creation, over the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner, in favour of Security Trustee acting on behalf of and for the benefit of the Lenders and for subsequent transferees, assigns, novates thereof and any refinancing lenders of the Project, by way of hypothecation and equitable mortgage on Project assets, pursuant to the requisite Financing Agreements executed in this regard; and_ _(c) Pass such other order/orders, as may be deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ 3. The Petitioner was initially incorporated as a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) and was a wholly owned subsidiary of REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited (RECPDCL) for the implementation of the Project. Subsequently, upon being selected as the successful bidder, G R Infraprojects Limited acquired the Petitioner from RECPDCL on 29.9.2025, following which the Petitioner became the Transmission Service Provider (TSP). 5. The Petitioner has submitted that, pursuant to the terms of Article 9.1.13 of the Facility Agreement (read with Schedule II of the Security Trustee Agreement), it is required to create a security interest in favour of Vardhman Trusteeship Pvt. Limited, _inter alia,_ as follows: - (i) The Security Providers shall execute the Pledge Agreement along with the power of attorney thereto, and shall ensure the perfection of the Security Interest to be created pursuant thereto (including filing of Form CHG-I with the Registrar of Companies, filing with the Central Registry under the SARFAESI and SARFAESI Rules (as applicable), filing of Form 28 / Annexure W, as more particularly set out in Part B of the Schedule 2 (Conditions Precedent)) prior to Initial Utilization Date. (d) Each of the Security Documents and the Security Interests over the assets created thereunder in favour of the Security Trustee for the benefit of the Finance Parties shall be in full force and effect from and after the time of execution and delivery thereof. 9. The Petition was listed for hearing on 25.8.2026 after notice to the Respondents. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) dated 25.8.2026, the Respondents were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies. 10. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner mainly reiterated the submissions made in the Petition and further submitted that, despite notice, none of the Respondents has filed a reply. Accordingly, it was requested that the matter be reserved for orders. In view of the submissions made by learned counsel for the Petitioner, the matter was reserved for orders. 11. We have considered the submissions made by the Petitioner and perused the documents placed on record. The Petitioner approached the Lenders for financing the Petitioner’s Project and availed a Rupee Term Loan Facility of an aggregate amounting to Rs. 2,623.20 crore as per the terms and conditions stipulated in the Facility Agreement with the Lenders on 5.2.2026. Further, the Petitioner, Vardhaman Trusteeship Private Limited and the Lenders entered into the Security Trustee Agreement dated 5.2.2026 and the Unattested Pledge Agreement dated 5.2.2026. A Securities Pledge Power of Attorney was executed among G R Infraprojects Limited, as Pledgor, the Petitioner, as Borrower, and the Security Trustee. The Pledgor agreed to secure the obligations under the Financing Documents, _inter alia_ , by a first-ranking _pari passu_ charge over the specified percentage of the equity shares and compulsorily convertible securities of the Petitioner, subject to applicable legal restrictions. _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ transactions. Accordingly, we accord approval for the Petitioner to create a security interest in favour of the Security Trustee, namely, Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited, by way of mortgage or any other security document over the project assets by execution of an indenture of Mortgage and financing documents of the Project. The Petitioner is directed to submit a signed copy of the Indenture of Mortgage for the Project immediately after its execution.
title: Petition seeking approval under Section 17 of the Electricity Act, 2003 for bringing on record the appointment of Vardhman Trusteeship Private Limited as the Security Trustee and for creation of security interest over the assets of Petitioner in favour of the Security Trustee, acting on behalf of and for the benefit of the Lenders (and for any subsequent transferees, assign, novatees thereof and any refinancing lenders to the Project), by way of hypothecation and equitable mortgage on the Project assets, pursuant to unattested Deed of Pledge, Declaration, Undertaking and other Financing Agreements, for the development of the Transmission Project.
